posts.title: 3 years, day 0
posts.description: On the 28th of October 2023. Three years ago today, I started a journal in Obsidian. I don't know exactly what caused me to want to journal in the first place. I never wrote about the reason. Something about the way I'm wired found it satisfying enough to continue year after year. It felt like I was building something. It still feels that way.
